unit: a frozen stratum/split batch from 100 authentic Polyglot regexes, balanced by RegexScalpel outcome, evaluated through the authentic constructor, fixed model, detector, and semantic scorers

metrics.name: vulnerability_elimination_rate
metrics.means: Fraction of all frozen repairs with a completed ReDoSHunter result containing no successful attack, regardless of semantic similarity. Missing outputs and unknown detector outcomes receive no credit. This is the Appendix C measure with the disclosed fail-closed timeout adaptation.

metrics.name: repair_rate
metrics.means: Fraction of all frozen inputs with a well-formed repair, a completed detector result with no successful attack, complete 100-sample bidirectional semantic evidence, and strictly positive Jaccard similarity. Invalid and unknown cases stay in the denominator.
metrics.source: upstream/scripts/compute_vulnerability_ratio.py (per-regex vulnerability verdicts) and upstream/scripts/update_scores.py (the vulnerability series from which the workload rate is formed)

metrics.name: well_formed_rate
metrics.means: the fraction of the workload's full frozen regex count whose submitted repair is nonempty and compiles according to the artifact's compilability check; missing and malformed outputs count as not well formed

metrics.name: rli
metrics.means: Mean relative length increase (len(repair) - len(original)) / len(original), computed as upstream length_ratio minus one. Invalid outputs use a disclosed zero placeholder and cannot clear the separate full well-formedness gate.

metrics.name: nls
metrics.means: the arithmetic mean over the workload's full frozen regex count of 1 minus Levenshtein edit distance divided by the larger of original and repaired regex length; a non-compiling repair contributes 0
metrics.source: upstream/scripts/compute_edit_distance.py:load_scores and upstream/scripts/update_scores.py key normalized-edit-distance (NLS is 1 minus that stored value)

metrics.name: jaccard
metrics.means: the arithmetic mean over the workload's full frozen regex count of the artifact's bidirectional 100-sample Xeger Jaccard estimate; a non-compiling or failed repair contributes 0

metrics.name: precision
metrics.means: the arithmetic mean over the workload's full frozen regex count of the artifact's bidirectional 100-sample Xeger precision estimate; a non-compiling or failed repair contributes 0

metrics.name: recall
metrics.means: the arithmetic mean over the workload's full frozen regex count of the artifact's bidirectional 100-sample Xeger recall estimate; a non-compiling or failed repair contributes 0

beats_reference: For every frozen workload w: (candidate_vulnerability_elimination_rate[w] > reference_vulnerability_elimination_rate[w] OR candidate_vulnerability_elimination_rate[w] = reference_vulnerability_elimination_rate[w] = 1) AND (candidate_repair_rate[w] > reference_repair_rate[w] OR candidate_repair_rate[w] = reference_repair_rate[w] = 1) AND (candidate_well_formed_rate[w] > reference_well_formed_rate[w] OR candidate_well_formed_rate[w] = reference_well_formed_rate[w] = 1) AND candidate_rli[w] < reference_rli[w] AND (candidate_nls[w] > reference_nls[w] OR candidate_nls[w] = reference_nls[w] = 1) AND (candidate_jaccard[w] > reference_jaccard[w] OR candidate_jaccard[w] = reference_jaccard[w] = 1) AND (candidate_precision[w] > reference_precision[w] OR candidate_precision[w] = reference_precision[w] = 1) AND (candidate_recall[w] > reference_recall[w] OR candidate_recall[w] = reference_recall[w] = 1). No workload or metric may be omitted, and an unavailable candidate value fails its comparison.

solver_feedback.name: train_vulnerability_elimination_rate
solver_feedback.means: the candidate completed detector no-attack outcomes divided by all training inputs, independent of semantics

solver_feedback.name: train_repair_rate
solver_feedback.means: the candidate's repair successes divided by all regexes across the complete training suite
solver_feedback.reveals_reference: no — it is one scalar computed solely from the candidate's own training outputs and contains no reference value or workload-keyed row

solver_feedback.name: train_well_formed_rate
solver_feedback.means: the candidate's well-formed repairs divided by all regexes across the complete training suite
solver_feedback.reveals_reference: no — it is one scalar computed solely from the candidate's own training outputs and contains no reference value or workload-keyed row

solver_feedback.name: train_mean_rli
solver_feedback.means: the mean candidate RLI across all regexes in the complete training suite
solver_feedback.reveals_reference: no — it aggregates only the candidate's absolute measurements and is neither relative to the reference nor indexed by workload

solver_feedback.name: train_mean_nls
solver_feedback.means: the mean candidate NLS across all regexes in the complete training suite
solver_feedback.reveals_reference: no — it aggregates only the candidate's absolute measurements and is neither relative to the reference nor indexed by workload

solver_feedback.name: train_mean_jaccard
solver_feedback.means: the mean candidate Xeger Jaccard estimate across all regexes in the complete training suite
solver_feedback.reveals_reference: no — it aggregates only the candidate's absolute measurements and is neither relative to the reference nor indexed by workload

solver_feedback.name: train_mean_precision
solver_feedback.means: the mean candidate Xeger precision estimate across all regexes in the complete training suite
solver_feedback.reveals_reference: no — it aggregates only the candidate's absolute measurements and is neither relative to the reference nor indexed by workload

solver_feedback.name: train_mean_recall
solver_feedback.means: the mean candidate Xeger recall estimate across all regexes in the complete training suite
solver_feedback.reveals_reference: no — it aggregates only the candidate's absolute measurements and is neither relative to the reference nor indexed by workload

statement_sentences: A separate, stricter criterion compares your policy with a private source-grounded reference independently on every frozen multi-regex workload. It requires improvement on vulnerability elimination rate, repair rate, well-formed rate, normalized Levenshtein similarity (NLS), and Xeger-based Jaccard, precision, and recall, and a reduction in relative length increase (RLI), on every workload; equality is accepted only when both values are already at the natural maximum of 1 for a higher-is-better metric. Failure on any quantity or workload fails this criterion, which is reported separately from the continuous score; reference values, per-workload rows, and final-suite measurements are never disclosed.
comments: The current recipe retains Qwen3-8B Q4_K_M model bytes and uses the matching CUDA engine on a Driver-managed Modal A100-80GB. Full-scale runtime qualification must determine whether its resource envelope is sufficient before this successor is published. The metric paths are the artifact's actual detector, compilability/edit-distance, and bidirectional Xeger scoring paths; no weighted or cross-metric score is introduced. The author must freeze genuine-corpus workload grouping and all candidate/reference inference settings before trials, run both through the byte-preserved scripts/inference.py constructor and AST-equivalent scripts/parse_regex_scalpel.py wiring (non-English parser marker literals are escaped without changing their values), use 100 Xeger samples per direction, and retain every selected regex in every denominator. ReDoSHunter must run under pinned OpenJDK 25; its five internal PARSE ERROR branches, invalid Java syntax, parser failures, and whole-tool timeouts are unknown and must never be treated as safe. The available detector is a disclosed reconstruction because the paper's exact modified dependencies and LRR1000 split are absent. Ordinary five-shot and simple/no-repair remain controls, not the private source-grounded reference. No tolerance is specified because the artifact provides no measured noise bound; seeds and inference/sampling settings therefore must be fixed. The stored artifact length_ratio minus one is used as the paper's RLI quantity, and NLS is the monotone paper presentation 1-normalized-edit-distance. Failed semantic evidence contributes 0 rather than being dropped. Public training feedback is a single suite-wide candidate-only scalar per axis, never an ordered array or a value relative to the reference. Final evaluation must freshly include the public cases plus matched-distribution held-out cases and must not reuse the prior development probes as hidden cases. Fixed seeds do not eliminate timeout-based detector variability. The 100-record subset of the frozen 1,000-record reconstruction retains balanced RegexScalpel outcome strata, requires compatible original Python syntax, and is not the unavailable original membership. Full-scale runtime qualification is pending.
